title_vi: Đại Kết Cục, UNKNOWN và Cứu Cánh của Trí Tuệ
title_en: Grand Ending, UNKNOWN and the Salvational Role of Intelligence
nonclaims: This object does not claim a newly proven physical law.
It does not claim that a literal cosmic enemy has been scientifically identified.
It does not claim a proven final fate of the universe.
UNKNOWN is not promoted to fact merely because a hypothesis is philosophically attractive.

core_propositions.text: Infinity is not equivalent to power, energy, agency, generative capacity, or reachable optionality.
core_propositions.formal: Cardinality(X)=∞ does not imply AvailableEnergy(X)=∞, Agency(X)=∞, or GenerativePower(X)=∞

core_propositions.text: Time is not an energy source; longer duration can permit irreversible processes to accumulate rather than generate new usable gradients.
A universe can be vast or unbounded while its reachable optionality, usable gradients, adaptive agency and generative novelty decline.
A low-generativity grand ending is modeled as an attractor class in which escape routes and meaningful reachable alternatives shrink.
core_propositions.formal: G*={x: reachable_optionalities↓, usable_gradients↓, adaptive_agency↓, generative_novelty↓, reversibility↓}

core_propositions.text: Life and intelligence may function as local counter-pressures by capturing usable gradients, preserving organization, modeling alternatives, coordinating action and expanding reachable states.
Intelligence is treated as a superstructure rather than a scalar IQ score.
UNKNOWN is relational and open-ended, not merely a missing scalar value.
Knowledge growth can increase the recognized UNKNOWN frontier.
core_propositions.formal: DeltaK>0 and DeltaU>0 may hold simultaneously

core_propositions.text: Epistemic diversity and cooperation can be functional defenses against correlated blind spots and unknown-unknown risk.
A more powerful intelligence can accelerate convergence to a bad attractor if optimization, cooperation, ontology openness and correction are defective.
core_propositions.formal: MoreIntelligence without cooperation/ontology-openness/correction may increase terminal convergence speed

conceptual_functional.name: Cosmic Optionality Functional
conceptual_functional.warning: Research heuristic only; not an empirically established physical law.
conceptual_functional.risk_condition: persistent dV/dt<0 plus shrinking escape routes => terminal-risk regime

terminal_pressure_layers.C_intentionally_unknown: Whether these pressures are the full story, projections of deeper dynamics, or evidence that the current ontology omits a fundamentally different layer.

simple_examples: Pi has infinitely many digits, but calculating them consumes physical resources.
An infinite chess state space does not provide infinite energy or agency.
An infinite game can still be poor in meaningful futures if all branches converge to the same attractor.
open_questions: Can reachable option-space be measured without arbitrary observer dependence?
Can deep novelty be distinguished from complex permutation inside fixed rules?
Does epistemic diversity measurably improve robustness to unknown-unknowns?
Can cooperation expand reachable state-space at civilization scale?
How can missing ontology be distinguished from sensor error, data poison or a weak model?
Can multiple different micro-laws independently generate the same low-generativity terminal pattern?
Is possibility-space ontologically open-ended or only open-ended relative to an embedded observer?
Can life and intelligence materially alter the long-horizon fate of their universe?
closing: Infinity is not enough. Time is not fuel. Size is not agency. Knowledge is not closure. Intelligence is not IQ. Cooperation is not decoration. UNKNOWN is not emptiness.
